title: Bounded search experiments and search spaces
summary: Search strategy, evaluator, scalar or objective-vector evidence, workspace/retention policy and execution placement are separate objects. dev5 supports both scalar ranking and Pareto front analysis while materializing only bounded results.
authority: Executable ooRexx ML source/tests are authoritative; recovered-audio integration is the first serious customer.
invariants: MLObjective owns MINIMIZE/MAXIMIZE direction; domain evaluators should return their natural score.
Search spaces are declared explicitly and compared before interpreting lane results as equivalent coverage.
Workspace budgets, reserve free space and retention limits are deployment contracts, not comments.
Requested evaluation count, unique normalized evaluation count and retained material count are distinct evidence.
Execution placement/transport does not define the hypothesis identity.
Multi-objective search retains non-dominated tradeoffs explicitly; retention may use Pareto rank/crowding but must not fabricate a scalar score.
procedure: Declare workspace and retention policy before launching the lane.
Drive the chosen grid/random/GA strategy through the same evaluator contract.
Promote only policy-selected candidates to durable bulk material.
Compare lanes only after recording search-space relation and common evidence basis.

provenance.claim: Pareto search candidates, front analysis and bounded front-by-front retention.
First-class objective, workspace, retention, parameter-space, search-lane and qualification contracts.
dev4 regression for search-space membership predicate repair.
